story.title: Dev & Test | Inbound 834 | CSGA | Table Update to EE_PlanMapping to Add New Rows & Assign Plan ID Based on Member Age

scenarios.title: Update existing CSGA EE_PlanMapping rows for under-21 age band

flagged.why: edge case never tests a failure path

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS_001_003 is "Edge", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record. Examples quoted from Test Step Expected Result: "Exactly one row is returned and it shows AgeMax = 251 for the under-21 GAMPTH02 mapping.", "No rows are returned, proving that a member at 252 months does not match the under-21 GAMPTH02 row.", "BoundaryMatchCount = 0.", "Exactly one row is returned for GAMPTH01, while the under-21 row remains absent for the same 252-month condition.", "OverlapCount = 1, meaning only the 21-and-above row matches and the under-21 row is absent at the 252-month boundary."

scenarios.title: Add new CSGA EE_PlanMapping rows for age 21 and over
Process inbound CSGA 834 from NAS through Georgia Health Coverage Program and archive on success

flagged.why: edge case never tests an edge failure

gaps: Precondition contains unresolved angle-bracket token: "A unique valid CSGA 834 enrollment file for Georgia Health Coverage Program is prepared for one member with Aid Category 198, a DOB that keeps the member below 21 years of age, a valid NM109 member SSN of [TEST DATA: member SSN used in the mocked 834 file], and a unique file name [TEST DATA: unique CSGA 834 file name]. The updated age based plan assignment logic is deployed in the CRT environment, tester access to TM is active, and the CRT file share locations are reachable." as quoted with unresolved path token in AcceptanceCriteriaRef rows: "\\day<env>appfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound"

Test Step Description contains unresolved angle-bracket token: "Copy [TEST DATA: unique CSGA 834 file name] to the NAS inbound location \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound." alongside AcceptanceCriteriaRef unresolved token "\\day<env>appfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound"

Precondition contains unresolved angle-bracket token: "A deliberately invalid CSGA 834 file for Georgia Health Coverage Program is prepared for one member with Aid Category 199, an invalid or mismatched mandatory enrollment value that causes TM rejection, member SSN in NM109 as [TEST DATA: member SSN used in the invalid mocked 834 file], and unique file name [TEST DATA: unique invalid CSGA 834 file name]. Tester access to TM is active and the CRT file share locations are reachable." as quoted with unresolved path token in AcceptanceCriteriaRef rows: "\\day<env>appfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound"

Test Step Expected Result contains unresolved angle-bracket token via inherited AcceptanceCriteriaRef in rows: "Then the original file shall be moved to the archive/success folder: \\day<env>appfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\State_of_GA\CCYYMMDD"
Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS003_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record

Test Step Expected Result examples for id "TC_TS003_003" are all non-negative, including: "The transmission shows successful processing with no policy unit error preventing completion." and "The original inbound 834 boundary file is present in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\State_of_GA\[TEST DATA: CCYYMMDD processing date folder], confirming successful processing and archive completion for the age boundary condition."

scenarios.title: Assign GAMPTH02 for members under age 21 with aid category 198 or 199

flagged.why: wrong aid category coverage is incomplete

gaps: Name field "Verify GA Medicaid rejects assignment of GAMPTH02 when member is under age 21 but aid category is not 199" covers only 199, but acceptanceCriteriaRef says "When the aid category is 198 or 199"

Description field "Validate inbound 834 processing does not satisfy the GAMPTH02 rule when the member is younger than 21 but the Loop 2000 REF*ZZ value does not begin with the required aid category 199." covers only 199, but acceptanceCriteriaRef says "When the aid category is 198 or 199"
